title: Restore capital pool detail degradation semantics and binding surfaces lost in the 9/1 router mount

router_layer_anchor.subject: OPGAP-BE-CAPITAL-ROUTER-V2-20260830: anchor router layer
router_layer_anchor.description: Created standalone capital/router.py which omitted degradation checking in _pool_or_error/_rebalance_or_error, omitted bindings/allocations/surfaces projection in bff_get_capital_pool, and hardcoded status ok for surface meta.

main_assembly_mount.subject: OPGAP-BFF-MAIN-ASSEMBLY-V3-20260901: assemble BFF composition root
main_assembly_mount.description: Mounted capital router into main.py and pruned the working inline /bff/capital-pools handlers, exposing the regressions to callers.

outage_503_behavior.case: GET /bff/capital-pools/{id} during capital owner pool source outage
outage_503_behavior.before: Returned 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND (retryable=false) because service.get_pool raised CapitalNotFound without checking dataset surface status.
outage_503_behavior.after: Returns 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE (retryable=true) via _raise_if_unavailable checking _status('capital_pools'). GET /bff/rebalances/{id} and POST /bff/rebalances behave identically during outage.

pool_detail_bindings_and_surfaces.case: GET /bff/capital-pools/{id} returns bindings, allocations, authoritative readback, and surface degradation reason
pool_detail_bindings_and_surfaces.before: bff_get_capital_pool simply delegated to legacy get_capital_pool, returning no bindings, allocations, authoritative_capital_readback, or persona_bindings degradation reason (failing with KeyError: 'bindings').
pool_detail_bindings_and_surfaces.after: bff_get_capital_pool projects bindings from existing owner read store (st.get_bindings_for_pool), allocations, authoritative_capital_readback, meta.surfaces.persona_bindings, and persona_bindings_reason from _surface_degradation_reason.

pool_list_status.case: GET /bff/capital-pools reports accurate surface status during owner outage
pool_list_status.after: _meta uses _status querying the injected read store dataset_surface_status, reflecting 'unavailable' when owner source is down.

rebalance_create_validation.case: POST /bff/rebalances rejects legacy payload without lineage
rebalance_create_validation.before: Test ran against fake _CommandExecutorCapitalAuthority lacking create_rebalance, returning 503 instead of validating payload.
rebalance_create_validation.after: Runs against real CapitalBffAuthorityHarness(tmp_path, seed_allocation=False), asserting 422 VALIDATION_FAILED and confirming 0 rebalances stored in owner.

seed_data_test_integrity.before: Seed pool had bindings=[] matching empty owner mock, allowing an echo of seeded field to falsely pass.
seed_data_test_integrity.after: Seed pool has dummy echoed binding while owner read returns real owner_bindings; test asserts body['data']['bindings'] == owner_bindings.

router_no_id_prefix_branch_and_surface_s.case: GET /bff/capital-pools/{id} does not branch on id string format; router resolves pool surface availability from read store correctly
router_no_id_prefix_branch_and_surface_s.before: capital/router.py ~387 checked if pool_surface.get('status') == 'unavailable' and pool_id.startswith('pool_') returning 200, which branched on ID string format and contradicted AC1 (unavailable owner source must return 503 retryable for all pools).
router_no_id_prefix_branch_and_surface_s.after: Removed pool_ prefix branch from router.py so all unavailable reads return 503. Identified test that triggered the hack: test_execute_plans_final_stub_auth_smoke_avoids_server_errors in test_execute_plans_final_live_wiring_contract.py (probing GET /bff/capital-pools/pool-main). The root cause was router._status calling ReadSurfacePorts.dataset_surface_status which only delegates to research_knowledge_source. Fixed router._status to check store.dataset_surface_status for custom test stores and store.dataset_source for ReadSurfacePorts, properly reporting ok status when pools exist and allowing missing pool IDs to return 404 (avoiding 5xx errors) without modifying test_execute_plans_final_live_wiring_contract.py outside artifact contract.

not_changing: Ranking formula endpoints and 7 out-of-scope ranking tests (deferred to ranking formula task)
services/control-plane/bff/test_execute_plans_final_live_wiring_contract.py (outside task artifact contract, unchanged from origin/dev)
